principle: explicit user output/style intent controls render presentation; character archetype controls face strategy, never final render mode.

asset_clean.description: clean character asset / white or neutral studio presentation

style_target_match.description: match a supplied visual style reference as the dominant final look

cinematic_final.description: final cinematic / painterly / dynamic key art instead of neutral asset output

style_on_asset.description: white/neutral asset layout while borrowing style language without borrowing environment

resolution_rules: If the user explicitly requests a white/neutral background and a style reference, use style_asset.
If the user explicitly requests the supplied style/final-art look and does not lock a white/neutral background, use cinematic_hybrid when an asset master exists.
Never infer white background merely because the character was previously represented as an asset image.
Face mode and render mode are independent decisions.
